title: In the Matter of BCO 34-1 Requests to Assume Original Jurisdiction
summary: The SJC answered three presbyteries' BCO 34-1 requests concerning Missouri Presbytery by reference to two Speck complaint decisions. One had upheld Missouri's decision not to indict on four allegations; the other had partly sustained a procedural and supervisory complaint and ordered a focused new hearing. The brief ruling gave no separate judgment or reasoning on the original-jurisdiction requests and did not transfer them to another court.

sources.supported_claims: Identifies the three BCO 34-1 requests and the two decisions incorporated as the answer.

sources.supported_claims: The incorporated decision found no reversible error in Missouri's investigation and decisions declining to indict on four allegations.

source_limits: The 2020-02 decision answers by incorporation and states no independent disposition such as grant or denial. The synopsis characterizes the incorporated decisions without equating their complaint rulings to a direct disposition of the petitions.
evidence_notes: Three presbyteries submitted the BCO 34-1 requests.
Case 2020-12 found no reversible error in the decisions declining to indict; Case 2020-05 partly sustained a separate complaint and ordered a focused hearing.
'By reference to' is incorporation, not referral to another body.
